userpage.loadFailedBody: Check the connection and try again.

profile.emailHelper: Nothing uses it yet. TierPlan sends no email.
profile.failed: Couldn't save the profile. Try again, and check the TierPlan logs if it keeps happening.

instanceAdmin.label: Instance administrator
instanceAdmin.helper: Instance admins manage users, teams, settings, backups and every environment, with every extra permission. This can't be given through a team.

on.title: Make {{username}} an instance admin?
on.body: They'll be able to manage users and teams, change settings, take backups and use every environment, including container shells and secrets.

off.title: Remove instance admin from {{username}}?
off.body: They keep any access they have through roles and teams.

instanceAdmin.failed: Couldn't change {{username}}. Try again, and check the TierPlan logs if it keeps happening.

disable.title: Disable {{username}}?
disable.body: {{username}} is signed out everywhere and can't sign in until you enable them again. Their access and team memberships are kept.
disable.failed: Couldn't disable {{username}}. Try again, and check the TierPlan logs if it keeps happening.

delete.title: Delete {{username}}?
delete.body: This can't be undone. {{username}}'s access, team memberships, sessions and pending links are removed. The username stays reserved, so the audit log still reads “{{username}} (deleted)”.
delete.ownAccount: You're deleting your own account. You'll be signed out.
delete.failed: Couldn't delete {{username}}. Try again, and check the TierPlan logs if it keeps happening.

userpage.enableFailed: Couldn't enable {{username}}. Try again, and check the TierPlan logs if it keeps happening.
userpage.unlockFailed: Couldn't unlock {{username}}. Try again, and check the TierPlan logs if it keeps happening.

errors.lastAdmin: TierPlan needs at least one active instance admin. Make someone else an instance admin first.
errors.stale: This changed while you were looking at it. Reload the page and try again.

reset.title: Reset password for {{username}}?
reset.body: Their sessions end now, and you get a one-time link to give them.
reset.disabled: {{username}} is disabled. Enable them first, then reset their password.
reset.failed: Couldn't create the link. Try again, and check the TierPlan logs if it keeps happening.
